about_short_description.short_description: Darent is a daily housing and property management platform.

product.name: Darent Vacation Rental Platform
product.description: A platform for booking and managing vacation rental properties including apartments, chalets, villas, and tents across Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Darent Host Management Tools
product.description: Tools for property owners to list, manage, and update their rental properties, including calendar sync and booking management.

product.name: Darent Payment and Financing Options
product.description: A payment system supporting multiple secure methods including installment payments for booking vacation rentals.

product.name: Darent Identity Verification and Security
product.description: A system for verifying user identities and ensuring secure transactions and communications on the platform.

product.name: Darent Insurance Partnership
product.description: An insurance service launched in partnership with Al Tawuniya Insurance to provide coverage for hosts and guests.
